The '''Document Bureau''' was a part of the bureaucracy of the [[Space station/Legends|space station]]&ndash;[[amusement park]] known as [[Hologram Fun World]]. In [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]], [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] and [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] needed copies of their [[birth certificate]]s from the Document Bureau so they could get [[Marriage/Legends|married]]; however, the office was closed in honor of [[Fun World Founder's Day]].
